entries.1af0fd60e3273d7f: This business provides asset management services. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, the indicator shown in place of revenue for general companies is the fourth largest of the six businesses. (both of which engage in investment management, investment advisory and agency businesses), and two equity-method affiliates that engage in asset management business.
